summary: Separate the fhr/fxr yawning entry from fhm

data.head: fhr, fxr (< MEA phr cf. SL 1158: to yawn;)

rationale: The fhr/fxr entry heading is stored in fhm.III.notes, and its following mfahər/(mifahər) stem and two yawning examples are stored as fhm.II. The explicit heading and r-final forms identify a separate root, whereas fhm means understand. Restore the entry boundary and move the entire yawning stem with its notes and examples; do not change the informants' statements.

rationale: The example ends in mfaxarwayno, with the past -wa- plus first-person ending, and begins aṯmәl (yesterday). It is filed in the plain Infectum box beside k-mifaharno. Preserve the dialectal x and the personal-communication attribution; the required change is to the tense box.
